@asweigart we'd be happy to move them to the subject list if you think that's more appropriate, but we don't duplicate links. For example if a book is more targeted to some looking to do game development than python development, it will find its audience better in the game dev section.

We've also experimented a bit with section-to-section cross-links, but now that we have a proper search facility, a user who finds a python book in the game dev section can easily find the python section.
